text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day before the Satsuki Sho, Satono 
Diamond received an encouraging phone call 
from her parents. She told them that she 
truly wanted to bring home a GⅠ victory 
for them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The morning of the Satsuki Sho brought 
stormy weather. They headed to the 
racetrack by taxi, only to get caught in a 
traffic jam.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was going to be late at this rate. 
Satono Diamond got out of the taxi and 
decided to run to the racecourse on foot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wondered if this situation was due to 
a jinx. However, resolved to shatter any 
jinx in her path, she rallied her spirits 
with fierce determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having made it in the nick of time, Satono 
Diamond finally steps up to run in the 
Satsuki Sho—!
